sources: Owner-approved Saraswati twin cities plan, 14 November 2026
name: Eru

lines.text: I patch above the roots. Cutting them would give me a sound wall and a courtyard nobody could sit in.
The older courses are sound. It is the fresh loose plaster I am watching.
The sound old courses do not need replacing. I work on the loose plaster and leave the living roots their space.
A shape can be steady in the air while its shadow runs over every hollow. I would like to see that.
The carver made the face. I made sure the base would hold without closing the way through.
